datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2014 and spatially mapped to administrative units in Somalia. The classifications represent food insecurity phases derived from standardized IPC methodology applied to assess population vulnerability to food insecurity.
